district.name: Dharwad
district.description: Cultural and educational capital of North Karnataka, Dharwad is celebrated for classical Hindustani music, the GI-tagged Dharwad Pedha, 900-year-old Chandramouleshwara Temple, and Unkal Lake.
district.descriptionKannada: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಕಾಶಿ ಧಾರವಾಡ, ಹಿಂದೂಸ್ತಾನಿ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಸಂಗೀತ, ಜಿಐ ಟ್ಯಾಗ್ ಪಡೆದ ಧಾರವಾಡ ಪೇಡಾ, ಚಂದ್ರಮೌಳೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉಣಕಲ್ ಕೆರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.

destinations.name: Chandramouleshwara Temple, Unkal
destinations.description: A 900-year-old architectural gem from the Western Chalukya dynasty, built with four grand entrances facing the cardinal directions, featuring two Shivalingas, exquisite lathe-turned black granite pillars, and intricate dancers carved in relief near Unkal Lake.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Constructed in the 11th-12th century under King Vikramaditya VI of the Kalyana Chalukya dynasty.
destinations.culturalImportance: A national protected monument that serves as an active living shrine for neighborhood festivals.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 4 km from Hubballi center, 16 km from Dharwad
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved municipal road near Unkal Lake on Old PB Road
destinations.safetyInstructions: Remove shoes outside the stone mandapa. Photography permitted without flash.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected under Archaeological Survey of India

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Masterpiece four-door Chalukya temple tucked away quietly inside urban Hubballi.

destinations.name: Dharwad Pedha & Cultural Heritage Trail
destinations.nameKannada: ಧಾರವಾಡ ಪೇಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಪರಂಪರೆ ತಾಣ
destinations.description: A culinary and musical walk through Dharwad's historic Line Bazaar where Babusingh Thakur's family invented the GI-tagged Dharwad Pedha in the 19th century from caramelized buffalo milk, paired with memories of Hindustani music legends Pandit Bhimsen Joshi and Gangubai Hangal.
destinations.historicalSignificance: The sweet dates back over 175 years to Ram Ratan Singh Thakur who migrated from Unnao during a plague and created the unique slow-roasted milk confection.
destinations.culturalImportance: Cultural capital of Karnataka literature (Da.Ra. Bendre) and Hindustani classical music (Kirana Gharana).
